lines.trans: Dmitry Vladimirovich is waiting for his fish.
Denis, bring over your culinary masterpiece.
German Mikhailovich, do you even know what is going on in the dining room?
There are guests out there. And everyone is waiting for their orders.
Well, we are cooking. So keep cooking.
Here is the fish.
Excellent. Alright, I will carry it out myself.
This is the last time I am helping you.
Can you explain this to all of us?
Why does this top scorer of the evaluation not know how to cook at all?
Guys, I will explain everything to you right now.
